Dam Good Watts Monday Mountain Bike Ride

Annapolis, MD · Mountain bike

When
Every Monday, 6:00 pmMondays, 6:00 pm, from the Housley Rd trailhead of the Annapolis Waterworks Trail. ABRT's rides page says March through October; ABRT's public calendar has no end date and says it goes year round, even in the dark. Trail conditions decide.

Checked Oct 5, 2026. The host's own calendar lists the next ride. Check the host's page before you go

How we know

ABRT's public Google Calendar holds a weekly Monday 6:00 pm 'Dam Good Watts Ride' at 2607 Housley Rd with no end date, and its training-rides page (2026 footer) lists it Mondays 6:00 pm March through October (both read Oct 2, 2026). Neither carries a dated 2026 ride.

Hosted by
Dam Good WattsCommunity-run
Kind of ride
Mountain bike

For visitors

You can be dropped, but the group tries to have a sweeper and sometimes regroups at the dam. Bring good lights for dark rides. For weather cancellations see the group's Instagram. Some riders park in west Annapolis near Chessie's Wharf for extra road miles.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
As fast or slow as you want; one counter-clockwise lap of Waterworks Park; slower riders can cut the deeper loops. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @damgoodwatts the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Dam Good Watts Monday Mountain Bike Ride group ride

Dam Good Watts Monday Mountain Bike Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Annapolis, MD. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Annapolis Waterworks Trail, Housley Rd trailhead (near the PetSmart).

A friendly Monday evening mountain bike lap of Annapolis Waterworks Park, starting and ending at the Housley trailhead. It takes 60 to 90 minutes. ABRT's pages list it as an open ride; ABRT does not sanction it.
